title: Cumulative Data Model Generation
description: Generation-time pipeline that replaces manually authored data-model.md deltas with a YAML-driven, schema-validated, parser-resolved, and deterministically rendered canonical domain model.

nodes.label: Developer
nodes.description: Authors data-model-changes.yaml; does not edit data-model.md directly.

nodes.label: data-model-changes.yaml
nodes.description: Machine-readable YAML file defining entity additions, modifications, and removals for the current state.

nodes.label: Schema Validator
nodes.description: Validates data-model-changes.yaml against data-model-schema.yaml. Enforces VR-01501 through VR-01507. Exits non-zero on failure.

nodes.label: Parent data-model-canonical.json
nodes.description: Resolved canonical model from the immediate parent state (014-fdc3-intent-interoperability).

nodes.label: Domain Model Parser
nodes.description: Loads parent canonical model and applies YAML changes (add/change/remove for entities, fields, relationships). Emits data-model-canonical.json for the current state.

nodes.label: data-model-canonical.json
nodes.description: Fully resolved canonical domain model for the current state. Committed alongside the feature pack for use by child states.

nodes.label: Markdown Renderer
nodes.description: Consumes data-model-canonical.json and produces data-model.md using deterministic rules from rendering-spec.md.

nodes.label: data-model.md
nodes.description: Generated markdown file representing the full canonical domain model for the current state. Do not edit by hand.
